He is positioned centrally in a studio setting with a blurred background featuring what appears to be movie production equipment like a clapperboard. A large yellow text box with black Chinese characters is centered at the bottom of his chest. (2) The scene cuts to a vertical layout where the top half shows the man speaking and the bottom half displays news clippings and digital articles from Forbes about a 'Netflix-Warner Bros. Deal'. He uses hand gestures to emphasize his points. Red and blue TVBS news graphics appear periodically, covering the lower half of the screen. (3) Visuals transition to high-energy movie posters including Harry Potter and Justice League (DC Universe) to represent the IP involved. Cartoon-style yellow blob characters with emotional expressions appear to represent public opinion, accompanied by floating text bubbles and a red 'Monopoly' stamp effect. (4) The final phase shows the speaker pointing towards a yellow background containing three numbered question points in black text. He maintains an expressive facial expression with active mouth movements, ending with a call to action as a yellow banner at the bottom prompts viewers to see more on his channel.

The voice remains clear and professional with high articulation clarity. The BGM maintains a consistent mid-tempo pulse in a major mode, providing an energetic backdrop. The BGM remains constant but ducked significantly below the vocal level. (4) The final phase features a rising vocal contour as the speaker poses concluding questions.
